content: The task was successfully completed with a reward of 1.0. The strategy of merging fragmented `<hp:t>` nodes within paragraph elements (`<hp:p>`) before performing regex replacement proved effective for handling HWPX XML structures where placeholders are often split across multiple tags. Additionally, removing `<hp:lineSegArray>` elements from modified paragraphs successfully prevented layout corruption/overlapping text. The month span calculation logic (inclusive month count) and budget formatting (comma removal while preserving the currency symbol) were correctly implemented and verified. No further adjustments to this workflow are needed for similar HWPX manipulation tasks.
